name: Paris
tagline: The café where the Revolution was sharpened, and the falafel with a line in Le Marais since 1979.

Le Cinq.description: Decor inspired by the Grand Trianon, inside the Four Seasons George V. Three Michelin stars.

Le Procope.description: Paris' oldest café, open since 1686. Voltaire, Diderot, and Rousseau all sat at its tables.

L'As du Fallafel.description: Le Marais' most famous falafel, with a street line since 1979.

Virtus.description: Signature Franco-Brazilian cuisine in the 12th arrondissement. Two Michelin stars, new for 2026.

Guy Savoy.description: Classic French haute cuisine inside the Monnaie de Paris, on the banks of the Seine. Three Michelin stars.
